tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Arlecchino expressing desire, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her Tall Female proportions, white and black hair, dark gloves and formal outfit. Give this emotion its own expressive full-body acting, genuinely varying leg positions, stance, body angle and gestures rather than locking the neutral pose: earnest longing and hopeful affection, flushed cheeks and open eyes; a slight forward lean, one foot subtly ahead, one hand near the heart and the other relaxed; tasteful and fully clothed. Keep normal pupils. Hands should be simple and readable; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two coherent legs and feet; varied bends, steps, stances and angles are welcome. Keep the complete silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
